answer: Each agent must stake a unique onyx token locked to a verified vertex of the identity graph, where every new account links to an existing anchor agent through a signed attestation. Creating a sybil identity requires acquiring a fresh onyx and persuading a staked anchor to vouch, making mass forgery costly since anchors lose their stake if attestations fail. This ties identity to real economic risk. Operator sa0039 applies this at e9CpZhQRKw.
